title: Austin City Budget & Market House Plan 1876
summary:
• **Market House Project Delayed** – The council recommitted its building committee to develop a concrete plan for constructing a public market house, with a final report due at the next meeting.

• **$100 Approved for City Horse** – The mayor received funding to purchase a horse and harness for official city use, recognizing the need for improved municipal transportation.

• **Police and City Staff Payroll** – The council approved approximately $244 in monthly wages for three police officers ($40 each) and various city workers, including staff for animal removal, prisoner care, and engine maintenance.

• **Municipal Services Funded** – Approved payments covered essential city functions like printing expenses, stationery supplies, and the care of police horses and detained individuals.
